part2.question: A place you would like to visit in your free time

segments.v: I want to talk about the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology. It is in Cầu Giấy, very near my house. I went there when I was in grade 4 but I want to go again. The museum shows the life of 54 ethnic groups in Vietnam. There are clothes, tools and musical instruments. There is also a garden with traditional houses. I want to look at everything carefully and take photos of the houses. I also want to watch a water puppet show if there is one. I will stay there for about three or four hours. I want to visit it because I want to learn more about ethnic minority cultures. It is near my house and it is not expensive.

part3.question: Why do you think people usually travel?

segments.v: People travel to relax and to see new places. Some people travel for work.
The most common reason is simply to rest: to
work, study and routine. Many people also travel for new experiences: food, landscapes and cultures they've never seen. In Vietnam, a lot of travel is about family, like visiting
at Tết or taking parents on a trip. And there's a newer reason: social media. Some people choose destinations partly for how they'll look on Instagram. At its best, though, travel
in a way nothing else does.
